about: card#11058 B1 — the planted seats the desk leaf guard replays beside every fixture seat (design § 0). Ported from the design-time script design-11058-leaf-diff.mjs; the base seat is fx-snapshot-4.json's aimla-pm. The last seat — a 64-character single-token unrecognised badge — was added at PR #268's review r1, after the baseline was written, so rule (ii) and the painter probe read it and the baseline does not.
